drivers.theme: Oil shock: East-West pipeline offline, Hormuz constrained, Brent triple digits
10y yield above 5% on term premium/supply, not growth
Earnings resilience and AI capex support
AI safety/regulatory rhetoric and Washington noise
Strategists trimming equity risk, 5-10% correction calls
Equities absorbing it all, futures only marginally lower

parsed.rationale: Futures soft as oil near $110 and 10y above 5% squeeze multiples for the wrong reasons, with a Fed hike tomorrow and guests cutting equity risk. Earnings strength and resilient tape cushion but do not offset the oil-yield shock, so modest below-even odds that fade with horizon.
